title: Limit blocks for players
description:
Limit itens for players
To prevent abusers, such as chunk loaders, entity blocks, etc., which could break the ground, a player can set a limit on the number of blocks a player can place on the ground.
body:
## 📋 Overview
A sophisticated NeoForge mod that provides complete item/block placement control for Minecraft servers. Works seamlessly with or without FTB Chunks/Teams, offering flexible restriction systems for all server types.

## 🛠️ Core Functionality
## 🎯 Limit Systems
- Global Limits: Set maximum items per player (/limite setitem)
- Personal Bonuses: Individual limit increases
- Group Bonuses: VIP/Premium group bonuses
- Real-time Tracking: Live block counting across dimensions


##👑 Administrator Commands
- /limit setitem <quantity> - Set global limit for held item
- /limit remove - Remove limit from held item (cleans all blocks)
- /limit bypass <player> <on/off> - Grant/revoke limit bypass
- /limit reset <player/global> - Reset player or all player blocks
- /limit group create <name> <perm> <bonus> - Create new limit group

##👤 Player Commands
- /limit check - Check limit stats for held item
- /limit list - List all global limits
- /limit help - Show help menu with all commands

##👥 Group Management
- /limit group set <name> <bonus> - Set group limit bonus
- /limit group add <player> <group> - Add player to group
- /limit group remove <player> <group> - Remove player from group
- /limit group list - List all groups and members

## 🧠 Smart Detection
FTB Chunks Installed: ✅ Integrated Mode
  - Claim protection enforced
  - Team ownership system
  - Ally permissions
  
FTB Chunks Not Installed: ✅ Standalone Mode
  - Universal placement
  - Personal ownership
  - Same command set
